description: Implementation of elliptic curve Montgomery operations for the BoringSSL/OpenSSL cryptographic library, including group initialization, point addition, doubling, conversion between affine and Jacobian coordinates, and Montgomery arithmetic functions.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_group_init
methods.description: Initializes an EC_GROUP for Montgomery curve operations.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_group_finish
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an EC_GROUP.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_group_set_curve
methods.description: Sets the elliptic curve parameters for the group.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_point_get_affine_coordinates
methods.description: Retrieves affine coordinates (x, y) from a Jacobian point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_jacobian_to_affine_batch
methods.description: Converts a batch of Jacobian points to affine coordinates efficiently.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_add
methods.description: Adds two elliptic curve points in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_dbl
methods.description: Doubles an elliptic curve point in Jacobian coordinates.
